n.quote:
Our sample included 77 individuals from around the United

States (60% male). The data were collected online, using MTurk. ... A simultaneous regression equation with the eight predictors, including the

three need measures and all Big Five dimensions, appears in Table 3.

p.location: Table 3, Study 5, Need for Dominance row and asterisk footnote (anomalous printed page 0, after manuscript p.69); Results p.39

notes: Identity independently verified from supplied text: title A status-enhancement account of overconfidence (typographic hyphen variation), Cameron Anderson, Sebastien Brion, Don A. Moore and Jessica A. Kennedy, DOI 10.1037/a0029395. This is a primary author-manuscript report with Methods, Results and tables, not an abstract or secondary article. Study 5 explicitly links need for dominance to combined overconfidence in an eight-predictor simultaneous regression; Table 3 identifies the matching predictor. Supplied p.79 locator does not match manuscript pagination; relevant text is on printed pp.36–39 and Table 3 has anomalous printed page 0 after Table 2 p.69. No PDF supplied, so no rendering possible. The printed .42 standardized beta and t=2.64 are same-test contextual candidates only, because effect size is unassigned. Table footnote gives exact p=.010, not a less-than bound. Method sample of 77 is a participant count, not an explicitly stated critical-model analytic N. No model N, missing-data accounting or final mutually exclusive groups are stated in the inspected Study 5 section or Table 3; no N inferred from correlations degrees of freedom or recruitment total. Replication, effect-size and reported-success fields are unassigned placeholders.
